output.one_liner: Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a SaaS platform for building and managing B2B/D2C and B2C ecommerce storefronts with customizable APIs and real-time inventory management.

auth.notes: Uses OAuth 2.1 with JWT tokens sent as Bearer. Supports public clients (PWA/SFRA/mobile, no secret) and private clients (BFF/Web App, with secret). Token endpoint auth method is client_secret_post. Specific grant types not explicitly documented.

evidence.snippet: To authorize this wide range of client types, we've defined a set of scopes based on the OAuth 2.1 standard.
Both the Admin and Shopper APIs are authorized using an access token in the form of a JSON Web Token (JWT).
The JWT access tokens for both SCAPI Admin APIs and Shopper APIs are included in your API requests as an HTTP header that follows the Bearer authentication scheme.

access.notes: Free Salesforce Developer Edition available for signup. API client creation is self-service through Account Manager (Admin APIs) or SLAS Admin UI (Shopper APIs). No vendor approval required, only admin role within Account Manager org.

evidence.snippet: If you don't have an org to test in, sign up for a free Salesforce Developer Edition.
To use the SCAPI Admin APIs, you (or someone with administrator access) must first create an API client.
The easiest way to create a SLAS client is to use the SLAS Admin UI.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Rate limits not documented in provided pages.

evidence.snippet: Determine the API families with which your storefront needs to interact: Shopper APIs, SCAPI Admin APIs, and SLAS Admin APIs.
Scopes control which B2C Commerce endpoints a token can access and define the permissions and operations a token can perform.
Extend your POS operations with comprehensive APIs, SPIs, and webhooks that enable seamless integration with external systems.

buildability.rationale: Free developer sandbox, documented OAuth 2.1 REST API covering broad functionality, self-service API client creation, no vendor approval requirements.

overview_evidence.snippet: Salesforce Commerce Cloud offers distinct solutions for B2B/D2C (business-to-business and direct-to-consumer) and B2C commerce.
B2C Commerce provides the resources and processing for your ecommerce sites, called a storefront.
